params.name: industry
params.description: The industry member ID. If the ID is not provided, the response returns the benchmark value across all industries.

params.name: naicsCode
params.description:
The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code. 

If the NAICS code is not provided, the response returns the benchmark value across all industries.
If both `naicsCode` and `industry` are provided, the response returns the benchmark value for the `industry` parameter. The entered `naicsCode` will not be applied.

params.name: location
params.description: The location member ID. If the ID is not provided, the response returns the benchmark value across all locations.

params.name: companySize
params.description: The company size member ID. If the ID is not provided, the response returns the benchmark value across all company sizes.

params.name: careerLevel
params.description: The career level member ID. If the ID is not provided, the response returns the benchmark value across all career levels.

params.name: matchDate
params.description: The date on which the career level was matched in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. A `matchDate` allows precise migration of career levels according to job architecture changes released since the match was made. If `matchDate` is not available, the migration assumes the most recent possible match date for the provided career level.

info.name: Submit feedback to improve salary benchmark values

items.docs:
Give feedback for a salary benchmark value returned by `GET /v1/compensation-benchmarks/base-salary` or `/base-salaries`. To submit feedback, include the benchmark value's:
  * ID values you defined in `GET /v1/compensation-benchmarks/base-salary` or `/base-salaries`.
  * `referenceDate` and `releaseDate` returned by `GET /v1/compensation-benchmarks/base-salary` or `/base-salaries`.
  * Optional `additionalComments` up to 750 characters.
